execution.cav_position_check: All 360 runs passed max recorded-CAV position error <= 0.001 m.

metrics.ci: 95% paired world-cluster percentile bootstrap, 4000 draws; 48 short and 12 spot clusters, both samples retained. State-cluster results also remain in remote summary.json.
metrics.other_csv_metrics: Complete 120 or 300 s horizon; t0 roster, entries off, native CAV replay and recorded HDV exits.
metrics.zone_speed_missingness: Absolute speeds condition on a nonempty zone within each arm. Ratio rows use common finite WM/recorded pairs and can differ from dividing absolute columns. No missing observation is replaced by zero; n_pairs is retained in remote summary.json.
metrics.merges: t0 ramp HDVs observed on mainline, without the original event extractor's pre/post trace-window censoring.
metrics.overlaps: Unordered same-lane footprint-pair contact onsets involving at least one HDV, including repeat contacts and non-neighbors, below road end 553.33 m; initially overlapping pairs are not counted as new. HDV-HDV-only onsets/time are reported separately.
metrics.train_scope: Approved outer TRAIN corpus; source-internal validation partition, matching the original BLOWUP panel. Exact pre-t0 inputs and all 241 original future frames preserved in the 601-frame spot export.

acceptance.reason: Genuine HDV rear-end contacts increase with yield under comfortable-only braking. Replayed CAV contacts also contribute to all-pair overlap counts. Emergency9 reduces HDV-HDV failures but is only a proxy for the full 13E mechanism.
acceptance.next_action: Merge flag-off into 13E, preserve its emergency and secure-gap mechanisms, and resolve the combined safety gate before enabling. No training was launched.
